title: Documentation Frontmatter Schema
description: JSON Schema for YAML frontmatter in docs/**/*.md pages. This is the canonical structural specification that formalizes frontmatter-contract.mdc and component-figma-traceability.mdc. Use oneOf discriminated on doc_type to select the applicable sub-schema.

doc_status.description: Documentation lifecycle status. 'draft' = work in progress; 'ready' = fully verified; 'needs-review' = generated but not manually reviewed. Distinct from spec YAML status (which only allows 'draft' | 'ready').

figma_node_id.description: Figma node ID in colon-separated integer format (e.g. '68:4097'). Pattern sourced from tooling/lib/property-type-map.json → figma_node_id.pattern. See component-figma-traceability.mdc § Node ID format contract.

oneOf.description: Placeholder when the date is not yet known.
Placeholder when the URL is not yet known.

non_empty_or_tbd.description: Non-empty string. Use 'TBD' when the value is not yet known.

pipeline_block.description: Pipeline-generated traceability block. Must not be hand-edited.

contract_version.description: Pipeline contract version. Must match TRACEABILITY_CONTRACT_VERSION in docs-config.mjs.

spec_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the component spec YAML file at generation time.

token_registry_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the token registry JSON at generation time.

generator_script_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the generator script at generation time. Optional: omitted when script hash is unavailable.

figma_component_block.description: Figma traceability metadata for component pages. Required fields use 'TBD' when unknown; optional typed fields must be omitted when unknown.

file_url.description: Figma file URL. Use 'TBD' when unknown. Prefer URLs with node-id query param for exact node traceability.

page.description: Figma page name where the component lives. Use 'TBD' when unknown.

component.description: Human-readable component/set name (not a node ID). Use 'TBD' when unknown.

last_verified.description: Date of last manual verification against Figma. 'TBD' is valid for draft pages; required to be a concrete date for doc_status: ready.

component_set_node_id.description: Figma component set node ID in '\d+:\d+' format. Omit when unknown ('TBD' is not valid). Must match the linked spec YAML value when both are declared.

component_hash.description: SHA-256 of the component definition at last_verified time. Omit when unknown ('TBD' is not valid). Used for drift detection.

properties_count.description: Number of component properties (TEXT + BOOLEAN + INSTANCE_SWAP, excluding VARIANT axes). Omit when unknown.

variants_count.description: Total number of variant combinations (product of all VARIANT axis values). Omit when unknown.

component_page.title: Component page frontmatter
component_page.description: Frontmatter for docs/components/*.md (excluding overview.md). doc_type must be 'component'.

last_verified.description: doc_status: ready requires a concrete last_verified date, not 'TBD'.

overview_page.title: Overview page frontmatter
overview_page.description: Frontmatter for docs/components/overview.md and similar index pages. doc_type must be 'overview'.

foundation_page.title: Foundation page frontmatter
foundation_page.description: Frontmatter for foundation documentation (colors, typography, spacing, etc.). doc_type must be 'foundation'.

workflow_page.title: Workflow page frontmatter
workflow_page.description: Frontmatter for workflow or process documentation pages. doc_type must be 'workflow'.
